text:
sara-pm: Quick status check — pricing rollout readiness for Friday. One-line status please: owner / ok-to-roll / blockers.

priya-s: Metering adapter is green on unit tests but we've got one flaky integration test (ingest ordering). PR #4680 in flight. Owner: priya-s. I expect merge tomorrow morning if QA clears.

elena-g: Billing schema migration ready except for the `billing_rounding` enum — product & legal need to agree on rounding semantics (per-tenant vs per-contract). Owner: elena-g. Blocker: final wording from legal.

ryan-t: Quota enforcement helm chart updated in staging (chart-pricing v2.3.2-rc). Deployed to staging for smoke tests. Owner: ryan-t. Requesting a 30-min maintenance window to flip in prod.

billing-bot: Alert: staging ingestion backlog detected — 22m lag on event pipeline. Auto-created ticket: #ingest-stg-3091 :warning:

qa-j: Regression on rate-limiter + burst case: observed 2x token overcount when bursts > 10k. Repro case and logs attached to PR 4680. Blocker until we confirm fix.

legal-ops: We propose "per-contract rounding" to avoid small negative balances. I'll drop the exact clause here by 16:00 PST. Owner: legal-ops.

marcus-k: Quick question on billing reconciliation impact: does per-contract rounding change invoicing math? @elena-g please confirm.

elena-g: It changes decimal rounding on the invoice line items; migration will write rounded values to the `billing_snapshot` table. I'll add the migration preview to the change doc.

sara-pm: Owners summary: metering -> priya-s; billing schema & migration -> elena-g; infra deploy & flag flip -> ryan-t; legal wording -> legal-ops; QA validation -> qa-j. Please react with :thumbsup: if ready, or state NOGO + reason.

priya-s: :thumbsup:

elena-g: :thumbsup: pending legal clause text (should be fine)

ryan-t: NOGO unless QA signoff on burst fix. If QA clears by 10am we'll flip at 11:30 for the maintenance window.

legal-ops: Will post clause by 15:30 PST. No objection otherwise.

qa-j: Will prioritise the burst fix. ETA for validation: 09:30 PST tomorrow.

marcus-k: Thanks — I'll hold the rollout slot until QA confirms. If anything changes, update this thread. We'll keep the rollback runbook on standby. :rocket:
